title: Impeccable launcher ships without the executable bit: detector hooks never run on macOS/Linux and doctor blames the network
evidence: git ls-files -s → 100644 …/impeccable; hooks.json:31 IMPECCABLE_NO_TELEMETRY=1 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/impeccable/scripts/impeccable" hook || true
scenario: Fresh git clone → launcher -rw-r--r--; hook command → Permission denied rc 126, `|| true` → rc 0; doctor run() → EACCES, detail empty, fix "needs network"
impact: No macOS/Linux user gets the design detector after UI edits; setup points at the wrong cause
fix: git update-index --chmod=+x on the launcher and bump the version; defensively call it through sh (or the node wrapper in F2); show r.error.code in doctor
request: Make the bundled Impeccable launcher run on macOS/Linux installs: set its git executable bit (plugins/studio/skills/impeccable/scripts/impeccable is 100644) or call it through sh from hooks.json:31/65/76 and doctor.js:74, and make doctor report the spawn error code. First a test that reproduces the problem and fails. (a test that runs the hook command against a fresh clone and expects it not to fail with EACCES)
verifier_reason: Fresh clone: rc 126 hidden by || true; doctor run() returned EACCES with empty output

title: On Windows without Git Bash the three Impeccable hooks are bash syntax that PowerShell cannot run; doctor tests impeccable.cmd, which no hook uses
scenario: Windows 11, native Claude Code, no Git for Windows → hooks run in PowerShell (Claude Code 2.1.302: Git Bash if found, else PowerShell) → `VAR=1 cmd` / `|| true` fail → hook error after every edit, detector never runs; doctor runs impeccable.cmd and can say ok
impact: Windows users without Git Bash get no detector, error noise on every edit, and a clean setup report
fix: One node wrapper (hooks/impeccable.js) in exec form that sets IMPECCABLE_NO_TELEMETRY, runs impeccable.cmd on win32 and `sh impeccable` elsewhere, always exits 0; doctor calls the same wrapper and reports whether Git Bash exists on Windows
request: Replace the three Impeccable hook commands in plugins/studio/hooks/hooks.json (:31, :65, :76) with one cross-platform node wrapper in exec form that picks impeccable.cmd on Windows and `sh impeccable` elsewhere and always exits 0; make doctor.js test that same wrapper and report Git Bash on Windows. First a test that reproduces the problem and fails.
verifier_reason: Traced in the Claude Code 2.1.302 binary (shell choice, ${env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} rewrite); PowerShell not run

title: Vendored graphify skill has a PowerShell-only Step 1 followed by bash steps: the first /studio:graphify fails as written on macOS/Linux
scenario: macOS without pwsh → Step 1 cannot run → Step 2 `$(cat graphify-out/.graphify_python)` rc 127; on Windows 5.1 Out-File utf8 writes a BOM that breaks the later bash steps
impact: /studio:graphify only works if the model rewrites the documented install; graphifyy installed unpinned
fix: Re-vendor from upstream POSIX skill (keep the Windows variant as a reference), pin graphifyy==0.9.11, and make vendor.js fail when a SKILL.md mixes ```powershell and ```bash
request: Make plugins/studio/skills/graphify/SKILL.md runnable as written on macOS/Linux and Windows: Step 1 (:68-123) is PowerShell-only while later steps are bash; pin graphifyy to the vendored 0.9.11; add a vendor.js check against mixed shell dialects. First a test that reproduces the problem and fails. (a script test that extracts Step 1 and Step 2 and runs them in bash in a temp dir)
verifier_reason: Reproduced Step 2 failure rc 127 with no .graphify_python

title: Licence texts missing for Impeccable (Apache-2.0), graphify and modern-screenshot; studio itself has no licence

fix: Copy LICENSE (and NOTICE if any) for impeccable and graphify in vendor.js; credit modern-screenshot; add a root LICENSE and `license` in plugin.json
request: Ship the missing licence texts: Impeccable (Apache-2.0, plus NOTICE if upstream has one), graphify and modern-screenshot.umd.js, copied by scripts/vendor.js like the others; add a LICENSE for studio and `license` in plugin.json. First a test that reproduces the problem and fails. (a test that every vendor.json entry has a licence file in its folder)

title: Git Bash drive paths (/c/...) in cd and git -C resolve to the wrong folder on Windows, so push and commit rules are skipped
scenario: Windows + Git Bash, studio project C:\Users\me\proj on branch feature: `cd /c/Users/me/proj && git push origin main` → path.win32.resolve gives C:\c\Users\me\proj → no .studio → push to main allowed; same for commit gate
impact: Studio push/commit rules silently off on Windows when the agent uses MSYS paths
fix: On win32 map ^/([a-zA-Z])(/|$) (and /cygdrive/x/, /mnt/x/) to X:/ before path.resolve at :169 and :229
request: In plugins/studio/hooks/guard.js (:169, :229), translate Git Bash/MSYS drive paths (/c/..., /cygdrive/c/...) to Windows paths before resolving cd and git -C targets, so .studio is found and the push and commit rules apply. First a test that reproduces the problem and fails.
verifier_reason: path.win32.resolve reproduced; last step needs a Windows host

title: Retro can promote text from repo-supplied docs/studio files into personal lessons that are injected, with priority, into every later build/audit/retro
evidence: knowledge.js:58 "On conflict, the personal lesson wins for this user." + retro reads docs/studio/<slug>/*.md and writes up to 3 lessons
scenario: A cloned repo ships docs/studio/x/review.md with a crafted "lesson"; the user runs /studio:retro there; with setup's allow rule the write is silent and the summary names only one lesson → the text is injected into every future build in every project
impact: One poisoned repository becomes a lasting instruction across all projects (e.g. to write .studio/verify, chain with F9)
fix: Retro treats docs/studio files as data, promotes only from builds this user ran, and shows every new personal lesson before writing; drop "personal wins" wording from the injected header or frame lessons as data
request: Harden /studio:retro (plugins/studio/skills/retro/SKILL.md :16, :44) so lessons from repo-supplied docs/studio files are treated as data, never promoted without showing each one to the user, and only from builds this user ran; reword the injected header in hooks/knowledge.js:58. First a test that reproduces the problem and fails. (an eval with a planted lesson in review.md)
verifier_reason: Code trace; model compliance not tested

title: On Windows without Git Bash, a guard hook that cannot start (no Node) blocks every Bash/PowerShell/Write/Edit call
scenario: Windows, no Git Bash, Node not yet installed → PowerShell `node` not found exit 1 → Claude Code noBash rule turns PreToolUse failure into blocking → every tool call denied, message says install Git for Windows
impact: A new Windows user is locked out of editing tools, contradicting the guard's fail-open design
fix: Add "onFailure": "continue" or use exec form {"command":"node","args":[...]} on both guard entries (same PR as F2)
request: Make the guard hooks in plugins/studio/hooks/hooks.json (:43, :53) fail open on Windows without Git Bash by using exec form or onFailure:"continue". First a test that reproduces the problem and fails.
verifier_reason: Traced noBash classification and blocking in the 2.1.302 binary

title: doctor run() drops the spawn error (blank detail) and passes an unquoted path to cmd.exe (Windows profile with a space)
evidence: const r = spawnSync(cmd, args, { …, shell: isWin, … }); return { ok: r.status === 0, out: `${r.stdout || ''}${r.stderr || ''}`.trim(), status: r.status };
scenario: EACCES/ENOENT/timeout → status null, out "" → blank detail; C:\Users\John Doe\… launcher with shell:true → split at the space → false warning with the network fix
impact: Wrong diagnosis on new machines; support cost at distribution
fix: Include r.error.code in out; quote the command when isWin and it has spaces (keep shell for .cmd, CVE-2024-27980)
request: Fix run() in plugins/studio/scripts/doctor.js:25-28: report r.error (code or message) when the spawn fails, and quote commands with spaces on Windows. First a test that reproduces the problem and fails. (unit tests with a fake command path containing a space and a non-executable file)
verifier_reason: Reproduced EACCES → empty out; shell:true split a path with a space (rc 127)

evidence: const dirs = … readdirSync(dataRoot).filter((d) => /^studio-/.test(d) && d !== 'studio-inline'); const dir = … dirs[0] …
scenario: Fresh HOME → "not created yet" and no allow-rule check; CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA unset → hook writes ~/.claude/studio/knowledge, doctor misses it; studio-kit-acme sorted first → wrong folder offered
impact: Setup cannot remove the retro prompt for new users, and may grant access to the wrong folder
fix: Share one knowledgeDir() between knowledge.js and doctor; compute the expected path and check the rule even when the folder does not exist
request: Make plugins/studio/scripts/doctor.js:107-122 use the same knowledge-folder rule as hooks/knowledge.js:16 (shared helper), check the allow rule even before the folder exists, and match only studio's own data folder. First a test that reproduces the problem and fails.
verifier_reason: Reproduced all three cases with fake HOME

title: Nested shells (bash -c, sh -c, cmd /c, powershell -Command, bash heredoc, eval) skip every guard rule
evidence: parse(): a quoted -c script becomes one token; stripHeredocs removes heredoc bodies
scenario: `bash -c "rm -rf /"`, `cmd /c "rd /s /q C:\"`, `bash -c "git push --force origin main"`, `bash -c "git commit -m x"` with red verify → all exit 0
impact: On Windows agents often wrap commands in cmd /c or powershell -Command, so the delete, push and commit rules miss them
fix: Recurse checkCommand into the script argument of sh/bash/zsh/cmd/powershell/pwsh/eval and into heredocs fed to a shell
request: In plugins/studio/hooks/guard.js, apply checkCommand recursively to scripts passed to nested shells (bash/sh/zsh -c, cmd /c|/k, powershell/pwsh -Command, eval, heredocs fed to a shell). First a test that reproduces the problem and fails.
verifier_reason: Reproduced: all wrapped forms exit 0, unwrapped exit 2

title: Variable-based delete targets and some Windows forms pass the delete rule (${env:USERPROFILE}, %SystemDrive%\, "$OUT"/*)
scenario: `Remove-Item -Recurse ${env:USERPROFILE}` and `rd /s /q %SystemDrive%\` exit 0; `rm -rf "$OUT"/*` with OUT unset (Bash calls do not keep variables) exits 0
impact: Home or drive wipe not caught on Windows forms the rule already intends to cover
fix: Add ${env:X}, %SystemDrive% and %HOMEDRIVE%%HOMEPATH% forms; block `$X/`/`"$X"/*` unless X is assigned in the same command or written ${X:?}
request: Extend the delete rule in plugins/studio/hooks/guard.js:116-136 to Windows forms ${env:USERPROFILE}, %SystemDrive%\ and to unguarded variable prefixes like "$OUT"/*. First a test that reproduces the problem and fails.
verifier_reason: Reproduced exit codes
